audio.strategy: Live Web Audio synthesis: a velocity-shaped, filtered three-oscillator modeled-piano voice with per-note attack, decay, release, sustain ownership, and a single master gain path.

generatedSources.name: Modeled piano oscillator bank
generatedSources.generation: Live triangle fundamental plus sine partials at ratios 2.01 and 3.98, with a velocity-controlled low-pass filter and gain envelope.
generatedSources.license: Original implementation authored for this benchmark; no external audio assets.

notes: No recorded samples, generated buffers, network assets, or third-party audio files are used.
The UI labels this voice as a modeled piano and never describes it as a recording.
If Web Audio is unavailable or startup fails, the status explicitly reports a silent visual fallback.

architecture.voiceStealing: oldest owned voice by monotonic sequence
